metrics.name: SPZ decode time for 500,000 splats
metrics.evidence: .spz is gzip around a fixed-point stream. Decoding 500,000 splats takes 0.08 to 0.17 s with numpy.

metrics.name: splat_inspect time for 500,000 splats
metrics.evidence: It builds no XML: 500,000 splats take 0.3 to 0.6 s.

metrics.name: start tag byte limit
metrics.evidence: libxml2 refuses a start tag over 10,000,000 bytes (all attributes together).

metrics.name: splat tool start tag budget
metrics.evidence: the tools plan for an 8,000,000-byte budget (80,601 at lattice digits).
